fields.label: Cardputer Wi-Fi address
fields.description: Enter the IP shown on ADV, for example 192.168.1.50. The automatic name iz2s-adv.local refers to the same device on your local network.

fields.label: Pairing key
fields.description: Generated by Prepare SD card package; it stays on this PC and the Cardputer.

fields.label: Switch keyboard Caps Lock state
fields.description: Match Caps Lock on Switch. If uppercase commands appear lowercase, change this setting. Source text and quoted strings keep their intended case.
